received_works.body:
Hi Bellhop!

I would like to request some more art of my character!

I plan to use this for music videos, youtube videos, tiktoks, and twitch streams.

This time, I would like artwork of my character pointing at the moon in the middle of the night. I'd rather the camera be a decent distance away, and also have the moon in the shot as well. I would pr The moon should be a full mooon, and I prefer if he was in a city pointing at the moon, but other than that, I will leave the details up to you!

I put additional references for the scene type I'm looking for in the reference folder.

Here's my references: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/156xfQs-GtTQ8e7QcRlvE76D-FOOTZosI?usp=sharing

Please ignore the ghost watermarks in the corners of some references.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/156xfQs-GtTQ8e7QcRlvE76D-FOOTZosI?usp=sharing

Hello, I was attracted by Bellhop's colorful and sparkling illustrations, so I sent this request.
I would like you to draw my character Leon. I will leave the pose and composition up to you, but I would appreciate it if you could give me an atmosphere that is recognizable as "urban" and "nighttime.

The materials are available on Google Drive.
In addition to the character sheets, I have also included other materials such as tone of voice and character relationships, which I hope will be helpful to you when drawing the illustrations. If you are muddled, you may refer only to the one with "CS" in the title.

If your request is difficult to accept, I would appreciate it if you could cancel it. Thank you in advance.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1n-lZMaNpU92zPfTwgak2Qo91jOLtIQ3G?usp=sharing

Hi 🙇 Nice to meet you, I am a VTuber! I love the elegance of your work and would like to commission illustrations for three characters (my original VTuber character and two other Vtubers). I am a mischievous tortoiseshell cat and have lived 7 of my 9 lives. I am currently a house cat and spend my time being pampered.

My siblings are my calm oldest brother (https://x.com/Abortius/status/1809995796160634993?t=p6HdH5SBeDgHdeOqL_ZM9g&s=19) and my serious but caring second brother (https://x.com/_ Kirangel/ status/1911999812838318358?t=eZEV2ffZ17PzqeEhB0Qg-g&s=19).

I would appreciate it if you could draw the three of us having fun together!

I would appreciate it if you could draw the background separately from the characters, as I would like to use it for twitter and twitch.

Please feel free to arrange the composition as you like!

Motifs: Family ties, chrysanthemums, peonies, celebrations.

Credits will be given. Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16bN8RnmZx8lXrv4PbJyljgno4VVRSRKU?usp=sharing

Hi Bellhop! 

It's me again,

Today I want to request art for a music video for one of my original songs. An editor will use the picture. It involves two characters. I've attached a folder with references and an example layout of what I'm looking for. 

The vibe of the picture is blue but you can use any color that you feel fit the mood and take any liberties that you desire! 

The song isn't completely done but I've attached the music file, but you do not need to listen to it, because it is very amateur music. 

We'd love the layers to be separated with 1) Pilot full body 2) boy full body 3) background 4) foreground rain/lights (optional). 

Bonus is to add mall variations like the city with/without lights, side profile/back view of the boy's face, or Pilot with her umbrella raised/lowered but this is optional and only if you have time!  

Thank you so much, Bellhop!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1iHYyRNZzzKoq6ht-5RJmcirsl0xXI_Ux?usp=drive_link

Hello!! I’d like an artwork of my oc named Ivan, he is a young bug like criminal in a dystopian sand world.

I’d like the artwork to have this action pose I put in the drive. I’d also like the artwork to have graffiti elements to it, specifically the symbol in the drive as that is his main symbol.

His personality is serious and angry because he is taking revenge on the people who wiped out his planet.

Other elements for more ideas: Wanted posters, Mechanics. Smoke, Rebellion 

Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CFol5B_ZSseMoHB5YAum6tWBn4-AOT4j

Hi! I really like your art style and I'd like some art of my vtuber character!
He is a runaway heir of a piano and violin manufacturing company who first became an underground DJ using supernatural powers to enhance his performances through realistic illusions.

He has a strong sense of justice, and isn't afraid to fight, but he's also nice and lighthearted. He's very independent but longing for the chance to create something.

I'll leave the pose and composition up to you! Please have fun with this!

I would like to use this for my Youtube videos and my Twitch streams as well as sharing this on Twitter and BlueSky.

Thank you for your consideration!

References:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/156xfQs-GtTQ8e7QcRlvE76D-FOOTZosI?usp=sharing

Hello! You have a beautiful style. I would like to request my OC, Leo. He is a forest spirit that hides his monstrous appearance behind a sweet human form. He is very cunning, and can quickly become attached to the people who travel through his woods.

Please draw him how you wish. He has a monster form and a human form, so I will link you to both. He can also "unseal" the mouth on his neck while looking like a human. Please note that he has a beauty mark under his left eye! Please feel free to change his outfit if you wish. 

His motifs include: Deer/foxes/rabbits, bells, dandelions, autumn.

Thank you so much for your time!

Ref Folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JG6iWNrmZxu8sxuDjcB9FM8d1c1XZk15?usp=drive_link
Bio: https://toyhou.se/11336460.leo-emrys

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JG6iWNrmZxu8sxuDjcB9FM8d1c1XZk15?usp=drive_link

Please consult with me again!

Also this time
I would like to ask you to create a secondary work to expand the image of an original character created by another designer in a creative activity.
I would like to ask you to create a second creation to expand my image of the original character created by another designer.

I would like to have this character play an active role in the future world.
Usually, he is a stoic character with a brutal (but cool) side.

We would like to use him in the following areas
It will be posted on our own introduction site and on social networking sites.
We are also willing to do some trimming.

We apologize for any inconvenience.
We appreciate your consideration!

https://twitter.com/oniyatsuhashi/status/1459945012263751681?s=20

Hello Bellhop-san! 

I am always a fan of the beautiful artworks you make. I want to request another piece with my character, Ed (エヂ)! 

He is an older man with a serious expression. He struggles to express his emotions in a non-combative way. He dresses in dark colors.

I would like for you to have as much fun as possible with this artwork and choose to do anything you would like.

He is 37 years old and 194 cm. 

Some of his themes are:
- Robotics/engineering
- Mechanics
- Red/black
- Wires
- The forest
- Trees
- Dogs/canines
- Authority/control

If the information is not enough, please cancel and resend. Thank you so much once again for your time. Bellhop-san is my favorite artist!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1jVtQo5sBAiMEj6WGiE0_2qxDC-qxrblc?usp=drive_link

Hi again Bellhop-sensei! 

I want to commission art of three people again. These three people help moderate my channel and I wanted to thank them! They are amazing. References are included in the link! 

Mystia is a girl with glasses in the frog hoodie. She is eloquent and cute! 

Ryudo is the cat boy. He is super wise and great at taking care of the people around him. His pants are black if you get down that far. 

Jams is wonderful and extremely knowledgeable. She is the witch whose palette is mostly black and white, with some places of color. Her design is not finalized so feel free to fill in the design of a whimsical witch for us. 

Can you give the piece a fairy-tale/story book vibe of an unlikely team? The composition and poses are up to you! In the PSD, can you also separate each character from each other and from the background layer? That way I can give the characters individually to them as well? Thank you so much!

I hope that you will be able to have fun with this one too!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UkHtPL39rG2Xx3Ebh6n_Qkg6kKYW4EAt?usp=drive_link

Hello! I love the art I see a lot, especially the way the artist uses color. I was recommended by a friend!

I would like artwork of my elf. Her name is Michel! She is a master of disguise who changes her face with magic masks. She is always full of joy, and a very dramatic and theatrical actor.

Important details include:
- her eyes are gold and upturned in a smile, always
- her eyebrows are black - painted over with makeup
- her lipstick base is black, but can be glittery or a gradient
- she is very tall, 210 cm
- the outfit is up to the artist! There is a folder for inspiration. She likes ゴスロリ, and gold jewelry and pearls.
- hair color can be more green or more blue, artist choice

Themes and symbolism include:
- mirrors and reflections
- masks and faces
- weaving thread
- iridescence and light
- stars

Feel free to make creative decisions. Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CJfTTpY4lNMl0ECy9dx0MKaQKuutm8IF?usp=sharing

Hello, my name is Kata. My name is Kata. My character "Bella" please.

I love Bellhop's drawings. I love all the past works you have given me!

He is a short male vampire who does not let people take him seriously by being flamboyant and hyperbolic.
He is a short male vampire who does not let people take him seriously by being flamboyant and hyperbolic.

He's really small and cute
He's really small and cute.

Please draw freely and have fun with this request! He has two different hair styles and can be drawn in any outfit.
Please draw freely and have fun with this request! He has two different hair styles and can be drawn in any outfit.

Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, and for your consideration.
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, and for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1ZxL8fgZ_Hga-Rr4Z-p_CljNjz7EOinco

Bellhop-san hello! I have returned and apologize dearly for before! I would like my same character to be drawn (but this time I have updated her design!) You are free to draw my character in her hero outfit or outside of it!

My character has a very stoic, calm, and cool personality, but she tends to get very embarrassed when talking to girls. I hope this is enough information to give you an idea for what you would like to draw!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DRVMb9cbGul08gEdRzRzhE4x2tURq8AH/view?usp=sharing

This is a request for an illustration to be used as an icon on the @X account @HakoYoshikawa and for advertising on X for a novel I am writing on Kakuyom.

Main character: Six-year-old boy. He has silver hair and pine-purple eyes. He wears a medieval European-style jousting call, a gilet, and breeches. Although he is a boy, he has a neutral beauty and is called a "fairy princess" despite his young age.

I am looking forward to meeting you. Thank you very much for your cooperation.

Hi Bellhop-sensei! You did fantastic with my last request and I am smitten with your art style. Today I'd like to request art of three characters, please feel free to change the price to what you feel is fair. 

My friend, Shdw, is the most affectionate person I know. We recently acquired a friend group and I think he is the reason we all stay together. He is not afraid to tell them how much he appreciates them. He is the glue. 

My friend, Arisa, has a very cute design but she is tough and strong and does mixed martial arts.  She makes sure everyone is taken care of and if she needs to, she would protect us with all of her strength. But she also has a soft heart, and is the reason it is so easy to open up to each other. 

Lastly, the third friend is myself.

I'd like the atmosphere to be gentle and warm between the 3 friends. But overall I'd like to leave the poses and composition up to you. I hope that you are able to have some fun with this skeb. Thank you so much, Bellhop-sensei!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UyBTh4RdfW6FP5q8E6nrKxLzAlUPcFqV?usp=sharing

Nice to meet you!
I would like to create a secondary work in order to expand the image of my original character created by other designers.
I would like to ask for your help in creating a second creation to expand my image of the original character created by another designer.

He is a warrior character who plays an active role in the future world.
He is a boy with a bad behavior but an honest character.
The costume can be the same or different.
He may or may not have weapons.
Tattoos are not required.
It is a setting that appears when he develops his abilities, so it is not necessary to have it.

We would like to use them in the following areas
We would like to use them on our own introduction site and social networking sites.
We are also considering using trimming.

We apologize for any inconvenience.
We appreciate your consideration!

https://twitter.com/oniyatsuhashi/status/1706695590233710996?s=20

Hello Bellhop-san! I really love Bellhop-san’s artwork, and would like to request a drawing of my character Kaoru. 

He is a hero with a kind heart that often puts on a brave face for the sake of those around him. He is silly and a little vain when it comes to his talents. He often wears smug smiles or playful expressions. He is very gentle when he’s being genuine. He is also a mage and scholar, and is often seen with books and study materials. He also smokes cigarettes. His white eye does not have a pupil, and it glows. Please include his hair pin in the illustration. 

Additional motifs: white lilies, sunsets, the ocean, marionette strings, and early autumn.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-HfeXU30SGgl8vNJA40ru-QaVs0Q1oTz

Hello! Bellhop🔔-san's pieces are always so nice. I would like to request another OC.

He's a cool seeming person, but is actually silly. He can have a temper but tries to keep it under control. He loves his work and always does his best. 

He used to be a bad person but has worked hard to redeem himself. He is able to control people's thoughts and feelings, but he tries to not use it. For this piece, I would prefer not to have the scales on his face!

Usual themes and motifs:
- redemption
- growing up and regretting his childhood
- the ocean
- dark and light
- grief

The exact pose and composition is up to Bellhop-san. Please draw him however seems right. His references are him in a suit, but it's not necessary to draw him in one.

Thank you again for considering my character.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1O1JFOIsTYMr0LRY6Woiry5aprOhmUsA8

はじめまして！
skeb新着でお見かけし、素敵な雰囲気の絵に一目惚れしました。ぜひ私と友人のOCを描いていただけないでしょうか。

▼キャラクター資料
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aE9sjgLLqqMlWGr9pi797S5aRsviE9xQ?usp=drive_link
新興宗教の教祖と信者です（信者はTOP2のような役割だと思ってください）。
ふたりは幼馴染でもあります。

教祖（ゆるい三つ編みのほう）
28歳、男、189cm。イメージカラーは「藍寄りの灰色」。
朗らかでおおらか、時の流れが人よりもゆるやか。常ににこにこぽけぽけしている。基本的な生活力がなく、どこか浮世離れしている。

信者（ウルフカットのほう）
24歳、男、175cm。イメージカラーは「琥珀色」。
軽薄な喋り方と薄ら浮かべるのがデフォルトで、信者じゃなかったら詐欺師でもやってそうだとたまに言われる。教祖に対しても態度は気安い。

教団内でのひとコマをお願いしたいです。
・朝、教祖の髪を結う信者
・二人で教団内の見回りをしているところ
・二人で教団内の見回りをサボって談笑しているところ
思いついたシチュエーションを挙げさせていただきましたが、これ以外でも、ご自由に描いていただければと思います。服装は簡略化していただいても構いません。

ご検討よろしくお願いいたします。

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1aE9sjgLLqqMlWGr9pi797S5aRsviE9xQ

Hello! Your art is beautiful and I would really love if you could draw my OC. Could I please have piece in 16:9 format. It will be nice if she can be in drinking coffee or tea indoors or by the window with a bright beautiful day outside. Please draw her having a great time chatting or having fun! Please feel free to draw her in any outfit you'll like. Thank you for considering my request.

https://kayaouo.notion.site/Kaya-Reference-Sheet-dcbc525a2b584b9ab7c5926e27019bc7

Hello, I would like to see my vtuber drawn by you! This is her wearing a detective costume https://imgur.com/a/detective-costume-nVZ47yt

If you could draw her in an exciting pose. I would like it if she had a smug smile. If you like, please have her posed with a gun in hand. I will leave pose and composition to you. Thank you!

Hello, I love your art! I would like to request an illustration of my TRPG character Vittoria. She is an elf woman living in a fantasy city similar to Venice in the late 19th or early 20th century. She has a sly, manipulative, and charming personality. She enjoys fine clothes, makeup, and wine.
I would like to see her playing cards at casino poker table. The scene should feel glamorous and exciting. I have attached a few reference photos for the setting and outfit, but feel free to be creative.
Please note her world has old fashioned technology. There may be electric lights and gas lamps, but there are no slot machines. Thank you for considering this request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1MlcdKE6UJyEwqMzF1t3uaGiGg2ek2qIa

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LYDVRAwdA9X88-uQq2YRgb_PuRTx3Gx_?usp=drive_link

Hello Bellhop-san! I know I still have another piece in progress, but I love Bellhop-san’s art and personality so much I wanted to ask for another one. I do not mind waiting at all!

I was hoping for my character Blythe. He is a nobleman and knight vigilante who believes it is his holy duty to purge the world from evil. He is usually very serious and holds himself regally, almost like a statue, but is secretly overly emotional and cries a lot. 

He has an ornate greatsword as a weapon, but please do not feel obligated to include it. He may be drawn in any outfit Bellhop-san can think of, even if it is not in his references. 

His body is unmarked, except for two symmetrical black tattoos on both of his wrists. His golden hair is the same colour as his eyes.

His usual themes and motifs are:
- Statues
- Religious duty
- Western religious symbolism (halos)
- Mourning doves
- Sunlight
- Angels
- Soldiers
- War
- Grief/loss

Thank you for viewing my request! I hope you have a lovely day.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1APpgiWl0RCyhO04fdbqFZVbuPd04rqFi

Hi! If it's okay, I'd like to make a request since I loved the first piece you did for me so much.

Dullahan. She uses ribbons to keep her head in place. You can draw her either way. Dyes her hair often, so feel free to choose the color (any color is OK!) for what looks best. Her hair color is naturally black, if you want to include roots or have it grown out a little.

At work, she tends to dress very classy, but isn't afraid of dressing casually when she's having fun. Examples of her clothing are in "Clothing".

She is a person who cares deeply but can be selfish. She goes out with people often but it never lasts long. Really, she wants to be loved but is afraid. She's the kind of person who feels alone even with people. Still, she smiles a lot and loves being around others. She is a friendly, caring person but is sometimes snarky.

Her hobbies are doing her makeup (or makeup on others), playing games, going out to bars.

Feel free to draw what you think suits her best.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xcDA7818kEDbil5KyeU3M3eVlIdsLuew

Thank you for your continued support!
I would like to request Bellhop to draw a character of my own creation!

I don't have any specifications for composition, background, atmosphere, etc. If you want, I would appreciate it if the facial expression is not a beautiful smile! I would appreciate it if the facial expression is not a beautiful smile.

The character's name is Hugo Zerola and he is the heir to the mafia. (Very happily, I have received an FA from Bellhop before, but it was too good a face, so I'm going to have another one this time...)
I've put together a few pictures in the link below, but the clothes tend to change from time to time, so as long as you wear a white suit, black shirt, and gold earrings, the details and other things can be different, as long as they are in the category of dressing up.

Thank you for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/19cvfm6CgrytkCN4r1VX2qbauSnU5Msm9?usp=sharing

Hello! I am one of the creators of the characters in this piece: https://skeb.jp/@bellhop666/works/9

We are both extremely in love with the art you created for us. Because of how much we love your work, I would love to request you for another piece of them. 

Like before: 

"The first character is serious but kind and caring. He was in an accident that gave him a lot of burn scars on the left half of his body. His hair is blond and his right eye is brown. He dresses in sweaters and button-down shirts.

The other character is often silly and energetic! He has one grey eye and one red eye. His hair is black. Sometimes he dresses in oversized sweaters and sometimes he wears dresses.

They are in a romantic relationship and love each other very much."

Alongside the original reference folder, I would like to attach an additional folder with a few more references.

Thank you so much for your time again!!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xKsIGCPZspEQ_L5ycJryxMOHqaTpVbcY

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SrX-GoRiigEfURduxXHww4CscnfF_1Lu?usp=sharing

Hi there! I love your art style so much!

I would like art of my Vtuber. 
Her name is “Pilot” and she is from the city in the clouds. Because of an accident during the end of her pilot initiation, she fell from the cloud city. Now she is stranded on the surface of Earth and cannot find the cloud city again because the city is hidden behind an illusion. 

She is playful but strong, like an older sister. Her demeanor is usually cheerful and lighthearted. She does not tell many people her worries. But sometimes, you can sense that she is sad and homesick. 

The pose and composition is up to you! I’d love to be surprised. 

If it is okay with you, I would like to use this art on Twitch and Twitter. 

Thank you so much for your consideration!

Here is a Google drive folder of references: 
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WUvXkHMcu6UL_mivocKW6uHn3t4TmlVV?usp=sharing

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WUvXkHMcu6UL_mivocKW6uHn3t4TmlVV?usp=sharing

Hello! I love your art style and the way you draw characters interacting.

I'd like to request art of two characters. 

The first character is serious but kind and caring. He was in an accident that gave him a lot of burn scars on the left half of his body. His hair is blond and his right eye is brown. He dresses in sweaters and button-down shirts.

The other character is often silly and energetic! He has one grey eye and one red eye. His hair is black. Sometimes he dresses in oversized sweaters and sometimes he wears dresses.

They are in a romantic relationship and love each other very much. They're usually very affectionate. The pose and composition is up to you and what you feel might work best. If the price isn't enough, please appeal for more.

Thank you for considering. :)
